920	They filled her up, smeared her with honey, just as the judge said, and "they set her before a company of bees," placed her before
921	a hive, in the place where they gather, and they gave the hive a bang, and the bees came out angry,
922	"and all the bees came upon her and stung her and swelled up all her flesh."
923	A horrible death!
924	And the girl cried out because of the bees, and no one looked at her, no one; everyone laughed at her.
925	No one had mercy on her, and her cry went up to heaven.
926	That is, HaShem said, enough.
927	How do you say it?
928	That's it, they sanctified their group, I need to go and set things in order.
929	What was there in Sodom?
930	What are the laws of Sodom?
931	We said, we already saw that Sodom did not like hospitality.
932	Each one of them loved only his own affairs.
933	So they had an agreement.
934	What was the agreement?
935	That every guest who comes to the city, except for your honor, would be abused sexually and robbed of his money.
936	That is, they take him, abuse him sexually, and also take all his money.
937	What cruelty.
938	This is Bereshit Rabbah.
939	Or they had another thing called the bed of Sodom.
940	When a guest came, they would offer him a bed to sleep on.
941	But if he lay down on the bed, it would consume him.
942	Why?
943	Because the bed was of a strange length.
944	If he was shorter than the bed, they would stretch his limbs until they came out of their places, to fit
945	the bed.
946	And if he was longer than the bed, they would saw off his legs to fit the bed.
947	It is written in the Babylonian Talmud, Sanhedrin 109, the tall one is cut down,
948	and the short one is stretched.
949	How do you say it?
950	Whoever is tall is cut, and whoever is short is stretched.
951	That is called a domain unto itself.
952	Well, so HaShem decrees the judgment of Sodom.
953	And now "the men turned from there" and the angels went "and they went toward Sodom."
954	Who goes?
955	Two angels, Raphael and Gavriel.
956	Michael announced the birth of Sarah, so he, how do you say it?
957	did his part.
958	But to Sodom go Raphael, to save Lot, and Gavriel, to destroy Sodom.
959	And Avraham was still standing before HaShem.
